title: AStarBodyPathPlannerParameters
Check for collisions: whether or not the planner checks for collisions.
Perform smoothing: Whether the body path plan is post-processed with the smoother.
Snap radius: The node height of a vertex is determined as the average height of all cells within this radius.
Min snap height threshold: When computing the vertex height, cells that are this distance below the max height are ignored when taking the average
Incline cost weight: This is the weight assigned to minimizing the inccline the path takes. The cost is determined by the difference between the edge incline from the nominal incline.
Incline cost deadband: This is a deadband applied to the incline in the search.
Max incline: The max incline, in degrees, that is allowed for the body path planner to traverse.
Collision box size Y: Width of the collision box used for checking collisions with the environment.
Collision box size X: Depth of the collision box used for checking collisions with the environment.
Collision box ground clearance: Intersection height below which collisions are ignored.
Smoother collision weight: Weight placed on the gradient for avoiding collisions
Smoother smoothness weight: Weight placed on the gradient for minimizing the angle between successive segments of the body path
Smoother turn point smoothness discount: Discount applied to the smoothness gradients of turn points.
Smoother min curvature to penalize: Min curvature in degrees to penalize with a gradient.
Smoother equal spacing weight: Weight placed on the gradient for making the vertices of the body path plan an equal distance apart.
Smoother displacement weight: Weight placed on a gradient that drives the waypoint towards the initial value
Smoother hill climb gain: Gain applied to the smoother gradient for iterative modifications
Smoother gradient threshold to terminate: Minimum gradient vector magnitude to terminate the smoother iterations
Collision start tolerance: Distance from the start to perform collision checking. Avoids false-positive collisions of the robot or gantry, for example.
Obstacle clearance cost weight: Weight on the obstacle clearance cost from the terrain map (0 = ignore YOLO/obstacle band, larger = avoid obstacles more strongly).
